## Analysis overview

This manuscript analysis tests whether patient-level usage of proximal
poly(A) sites responsive to dual methyltransferase inhibition (DMAi) is
associated with overall survival in TCGA. The matched non-DMAi site score is
included as a background APA control.

The analysis comprises:

1. a primary-tumour pan-cancer Cox model adjusted for age and sex and
   stratified by cancer project;
2. cancer-specific models testing the DMAi score itself;
3. parallel models testing selective DMAi usage, defined as the patient-level
   DMAi-minus-non-DMAi contrast while controlling for overall APA usage; and
4. adjusted survival predictions for the cancer with the strongest adverse
   selective-usage association.

## Methods

### Cohort and APA scores

For each RNA sample, the DMAi and non-DMAi scores were defined as the median
proximal poly(A)-site usage across the corresponding experimentally defined
site set.
RNA samples were required to quantify at least
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * params$minimum_site_coverage_fraction)` of the
maximum observed number of sites in both sets. When multiple eligible RNA
samples were available for one patient, their sample-level scores were
collapsed using the median.

The survival analysis was restricted to patients represented by a primary
solid-tumour RNA sample. Overall-survival time and status, age at diagnosis,
and sex were obtained through the public cBioPortal API for the TCGA PanCancer
Atlas studies and cached with the analysis inputs. Death was defined by an
`OS_STATUS` value beginning with `1:`; values beginning with `0:` were
censored. Patients without valid overall-survival, age, or sex data were
excluded.

### Pan-cancer survival model

DMAi and non-DMAi scores were centred and scaled separately within each
cancer project. A Cox proportional-hazards model included both continuous
scores, age per 10-year increase, and sex. Cancer project was included as a
stratum, allowing each cancer type to have its own baseline hazard. Hazard
ratios therefore represent the change in mortality hazard per one
within-cancer standard-deviation increase in site usage. Ties were handled
using the Efron method. Proportional hazards were assessed using Schoenfeld
residuals.

Selective DMAi usage was defined for each patient as DMAi median usage minus
non-DMAi median usage. Overall APA usage was defined as the mean of these two
scores. Both quantities were centred and scaled within cancer project. A
second stratified Cox model included the selective contrast, overall APA
usage, age, and sex. Adjustment for overall APA usage separates relative
enrichment of DMAi-site usage from a general shift affecting both site sets.

### Cancer-specific screen

Cancer-specific Cox models were restricted to projects with at least
`r params$minimum_project_patients` eligible patients and
`r params$minimum_project_events` deaths. Direct-score models included
continuous within-cancer standardized DMAi usage and age per 10 years.
Selective-usage models included the standardized DMAi-minus-non-DMAi contrast,
standardized overall APA usage, and age. Sex was included when both sexes were
represented within a cancer; it was omitted for sex-specific cancers because
an invariant covariate cannot be estimated. Two-sided Wald p-values were
adjusted separately across eligible cancers for the direct and selective
screens using the Benjamini--Hochberg false-discovery rate (FDR). All eligible
cancers are reported in the forest plots.

### Selected-cancer analysis

For visualization, adjusted survival was predicted at the within-cancer 25th
and 75th percentiles of the continuous DMAi-minus-non-DMAi contrast. For each
contrast value, counterfactual predictions retained every patient's observed
overall APA usage, age, and sex and were averaged across the selected-cancer
cohort. This marginal standardization directly visualizes the fitted Cox
model without dichotomizing patients or introducing a survival-analysis
threshold. Pointwise 95% confidence intervals were estimated using
`r params$survival_bootstrap_replicates` nonparametric patient-level bootstrap
resamples. In each resample, the Cox model was refitted and survival was
standardized over the resampled covariate distribution while holding the
contrast at the original-cohort percentile values. Cancer selection and the
adjusted survival visualization are considered exploratory. At
`r params$survival_summary_months` months, the adjusted survival difference
between the 25th- and 75th-percentile scenarios was calculated within every
paired bootstrap resample, and its 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles defined the
95% confidence interval. All tests were two-sided.
Analyses were performed in R 4.5.1 using the `survival` package (version
3.8-3).

```{r setup}
library(data.table)

library(knitr)
library(scales)

find_repository_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    has_git_directory <- dir.exists(file.path(candidate, ".git"))
    has_repository_directories <-
      dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "Scripts")) &&
      (
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "Data")) ||
          dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "data"))
      )
    if (has_git_directory || has_repository_directories) {
      return(candidate)
    }
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) {
      stop("Could not locate the PRMT-APA repository root.")
    }
    candidate <- parent
  }
}

resolve_repository_path <- function(path, must_work = FALSE) {
  expanded_path <- path.expand(path)
  is_absolute <- grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", expanded_path)
  resolved_path <- if (is_absolute) {
    expanded_path
  } else {
    file.path(repository_root, expanded_path)
  }
  normalizePath(resolved_path, mustWork = must_work)
}

repository_root <- find_repository_root()

figure_output_dir <- resolve_repository_path(params$figure_output_dir)

prediction_colours <- c(
  "Lower relative DMAi-site usage (25th percentile)" = "#1A85FF",

standardise_score <- function(x) {
  score_sd <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(score_sd) || score_sd == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }
  (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / score_sd
}

single_value <- function(x, field, patient) {
  values <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(values) != 1L) {
    stop("Patient ", patient, " has multiple ", field, " values.")
  }
  values
}

tidy_score_term <- function(fit, term, model) {
  target_term <- term
  result <- as.data.table(
    tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
  )[term == target_term]
  data.table(
    model = model,
    hazard_ratio = result$estimate,
    conf_low = result$conf.low,
    conf_high = result$conf.high,
    p_value = result$p.value
  )
}
```

## Construct the patient cohort

```{r load-and-filter-scores}
score_file <- resolve_repository_path(params$score_file, must_work = TRUE)
clinical_file <- resolve_repository_path(params$clinical_file)

sample_scores <- fread(score_file)
required_score_columns <- c(
  "studyId", "patientId", "project_id", "cancer_type", "sample_type",
  "dmai_median_usage", "non_dmai_median_usage",
  "n_dmai_sites_observed", "n_non_dmai_sites_observed"
)
missing_score_columns <- setdiff(
  required_score_columns,
  names(sample_scores)
)
if (length(missing_score_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The score file is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_score_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

clinical_patient_keys <- unique(
  sample_scores[, .(studyId, patientId)]
)

sample_scores <- sample_scores[
  !is.na(studyId) &
    !is.na(patientId) &
    !is.na(project_id) &
    is.finite(dmai_median_usage) &
    is.finite(non_dmai_median_usage)
]

coverage_fraction <- as.numeric(params$minimum_site_coverage_fraction)
if (
  !is.finite(coverage_fraction) ||
    coverage_fraction <= 0 ||
    coverage_fraction > 1
) {
  stop("`minimum_site_coverage_fraction` must be in (0, 1].")
}

maximum_dmai_sites <- max(sample_scores$n_dmai_sites_observed)
maximum_non_dmai_sites <- max(sample_scores$n_non_dmai_sites_observed)
minimum_dmai_sites <- ceiling(coverage_fraction * maximum_dmai_sites)
minimum_non_dmai_sites <- ceiling(
  coverage_fraction * maximum_non_dmai_sites
)

n_samples_before_coverage <- nrow(sample_scores)
sample_scores <- sample_scores[
  n_dmai_sites_observed >= minimum_dmai_sites &
    n_non_dmai_sites_observed >= minimum_non_dmai_sites
]

coverage_qc <- data.table(
  site_group = c("DMAi", "non-DMAi"),
  maximum_observed_sites = c(
    maximum_dmai_sites,
    maximum_non_dmai_sites
  ),
  minimum_required_sites = c(
    minimum_dmai_sites,
    minimum_non_dmai_sites
  ),
  samples_before_filter = n_samples_before_coverage,
  samples_after_filter = nrow(sample_scores),
  samples_excluded = n_samples_before_coverage - nrow(sample_scores)
)
kable(
  coverage_qc,
  caption = "APA site-coverage filter"
)
```

```{r retrieve-clinical-data}
required_clinical_attributes <- c(
  "OS_MONTHS", "OS_STATUS", "AGE", "SEX"
)

fetch_cbioportal_patient_clinical <- function(
  study_ids,
  api_base_url
) {
  api_base_url <- sub("/+$", "", api_base_url)
  clinical_by_study <- lapply(sort(unique(study_ids)), function(study_id) {
    endpoint <- paste0(
      api_base_url,
      "/studies/",
      utils::URLencode(study_id, reserved = TRUE),
      "/clinical-data"
    )
    response <- request(endpoint) |>
      req_url_query(
        clinicalDataType = "PATIENT",
        projection = "SUMMARY",
        pageSize = 100000,
        pageNumber = 0
      ) |>
      req_user_agent("PRMT-APA survival analysis") |>
      req_timeout(seconds = 60) |>
      req_retry(max_tries = 5) |>
      req_perform()

    study_clinical <- as.data.table(
      resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)
    )
    required_api_columns <- c(
      "studyId", "patientId", "clinicalAttributeId", "value"
    )
    missing_api_columns <- setdiff(
      required_api_columns,
      names(study_clinical)
    )
    if (length(missing_api_columns)) {
      stop(
        "cBioPortal returned an unexpected clinical-data response for ",
        study_id,
        "."
      )
    }
    study_clinical[
      clinicalAttributeId %chin% required_clinical_attributes,
      ..required_api_columns
    ]
  })

  clinical_long <- rbindlist(clinical_by_study, use.names = TRUE)
  duplicated_attributes <- clinical_long[
    , .N,
    by = .(studyId, patientId, clinicalAttributeId)
  ][N > 1L]
  if (nrow(duplicated_attributes)) {
    stop("cBioPortal returned duplicate patient clinical attributes.")
  }

  clinical_wide <- dcast(
    clinical_long,
    studyId + patientId ~ clinicalAttributeId,
    value.var = "value"
  )
  missing_attributes <- setdiff(
    required_clinical_attributes,
    names(clinical_wide)
  )
  if (length(missing_attributes)) {
    stop(
      "The downloaded clinical data lack required attributes: ",
      paste(missing_attributes, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  setcolorder(
    clinical_wide,
    c("studyId", "patientId", required_clinical_attributes)
  )
  setorder(clinical_wide, studyId, patientId)
  clinical_wide[, retrieved_utc := format(
    Sys.time(),
    tz = "UTC",
    usetz = TRUE
  )]
  clinical_wide
}

refresh_clinical <- isTRUE(params$refresh_clinical)
clinical_was_downloaded <- refresh_clinical || !file.exists(clinical_file)
if (clinical_was_downloaded) {
  dir.create(
    dirname(clinical_file),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  downloaded_clinical <- fetch_cbioportal_patient_clinical(
    clinical_patient_keys$studyId,
    params$cbioportal_api_url
  )
  downloaded_clinical <- merge(
    clinical_patient_keys,
    downloaded_clinical,
    by = c("studyId", "patientId"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  downloaded_clinical[, retrieved_utc := format(
    Sys.time(),
    tz = "UTC",
    usetz = TRUE
  )]
  setorder(downloaded_clinical, studyId, patientId)
  fwrite(downloaded_clinical, clinical_file, sep = "\t")
}
clinical_file <- normalizePath(clinical_file, mustWork = TRUE)

clinical_cache_qc <- data.table(
  source = if (
    clinical_was_downloaded
  ) "Downloaded from cBioPortal API" else "Existing committed cache",
  clinical_file = clinical_file,
  studies_requested = uniqueN(clinical_patient_keys$studyId),
  retrieved_utc = paste(
    unique(fread(
      clinical_file,
      select = "retrieved_utc",
      colClasses = "character"
    )$retrieved_utc),
    collapse = "; "
  )
)
kable(clinical_cache_qc, caption = "Clinical-data provenance")
```

```{r collapse-to-patients}
patient_usage <- sample_scores[, {
  current_patient <- patientId[1L]
  list(
    project_id = single_value(
      project_id,
      "project_id",
      current_patient
    ),
    cancer_type = single_value(
      cancer_type,
      "cancer_type",
      current_patient
    ),
    n_apa_samples = .N,
    sample_types = paste(
      sort(unique(sample_type[!is.na(sample_type)])),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    minimum_dmai_sites_observed = min(n_dmai_sites_observed),
    minimum_non_dmai_sites_observed = min(
      n_non_dmai_sites_observed
    ),
    dmai_median_usage = median(dmai_median_usage),
    non_dmai_median_usage = median(non_dmai_median_usage)
  )
}, by = .(studyId, patientId)]

if (anyDuplicated(patient_usage[, .(studyId, patientId)])) {
  stop("Patient-level APA data contain duplicate study/patient keys.")
}
```

```{r merge-clinical-data}
clinical_data <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  colClasses = "character"
)
required_clinical_columns <- c(
  "studyId", "patientId", "OS_MONTHS", "OS_STATUS", "AGE", "SEX"
)
missing_clinical_columns <- setdiff(
  required_clinical_columns,
  names(clinical_data)
)
if (length(missing_clinical_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The clinical file is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_clinical_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

analysis_data <- merge(
  patient_usage,
  clinical_data[, ..required_clinical_columns],
  by = c("studyId", "patientId"),
  all = FALSE
)
analysis_data[, os_months := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS_MONTHS))]
analysis_data[
  !is.na(OS_STATUS) & !nzchar(trimws(OS_STATUS)),
  OS_STATUS := NA_character_
]
analysis_data[, os_event := fcase(
  grepl("^1:", OS_STATUS), 1L,
  grepl("^0:", OS_STATUS), 0L,
  default = NA_integer_
)]
analysis_data[, age_years := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AGE))]
analysis_data[
  !is.finite(age_years) | age_years <= 0 | age_years >= 120,
  age_years := NA_real_
]
analysis_data[, sex := factor(
  fcase(
    toupper(trimws(SEX)) == "FEMALE", "Female",
    toupper(trimws(SEX)) == "MALE", "Male",
    default = NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c("Female", "Male")
)]

primary_sample_types <- c("Primary Tumor", "Primary solid Tumor")
is_valid_survival <- is.finite(analysis_data$os_months) &
  analysis_data$os_months >= 0 &
  !is.na(analysis_data$os_event)
is_primary <- analysis_data$sample_types %chin% primary_sample_types
is_clinically_complete <- !is.na(analysis_data$age_years) &
  !is.na(analysis_data$sex)

cohort_flow <- data.table(
  analysis_step = c(
    "Patients with APA and clinical mapping",
    "Valid overall-survival endpoint",
    "Primary solid-tumour RNA sample",
    "Complete age and sex"
  ),
  patients = c(
    nrow(analysis_data),
    sum(is_valid_survival),
    sum(is_valid_survival & is_primary),
    sum(is_valid_survival & is_primary & is_clinically_complete)
  )
)
kable(cohort_flow, caption = "Survival cohort construction")

analysis_data <- analysis_data[
  is_valid_survival &
    is_primary &
    is_clinically_complete
]
analysis_data[, age_per_10_years := age_years / 10]
analysis_data[, dmai_usage_z := standardise_score(
  dmai_median_usage
), by = project_id]
analysis_data[, non_dmai_usage_z := standardise_score(
  non_dmai_median_usage
), by = project_id]
analysis_data[, selective_dmai_usage :=
  dmai_median_usage - non_dmai_median_usage]
analysis_data[, overall_apa_usage :=
  (dmai_median_usage + non_dmai_median_usage) / 2]
analysis_data[, selective_dmai_usage_z := standardise_score(
  selective_dmai_usage
), by = project_id]
analysis_data[, overall_apa_usage_z := standardise_score(
  overall_apa_usage
), by = project_id]
analysis_data <- analysis_data[
  is.finite(dmai_usage_z) &
    is.finite(non_dmai_usage_z) &
    is.finite(selective_dmai_usage_z) &
    is.finite(overall_apa_usage_z)
]

cohort_summary <- analysis_data[, .(
  patients = .N,
  deaths = sum(os_event),
  cancer_projects = uniqueN(project_id),
  patients_with_multiple_apa_samples = sum(n_apa_samples > 1L)
)]
kable(
  cohort_summary,
  caption = "Final primary-tumour age/sex analysis cohort"
)
```

## Primary pan-cancer Cox model

```{r pan-cancer-cox}
pan_cancer_fit <- coxph(
  Surv(os_months, os_event) ~
    dmai_usage_z +
    non_dmai_usage_z +
    age_per_10_years +
    sex +
    strata(project_id),
  data = analysis_data,
  ties = "efron",
  x = TRUE
)

pan_cancer_results <- rbindlist(list(
  tidy_score_term(
    pan_cancer_fit,
    "dmai_usage_z",
    "DMAi"
  ),
  tidy_score_term(
    pan_cancer_fit,
    "non_dmai_usage_z",
    "non-DMAi"
  )
))
kable(
  pan_cancer_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Age- and sex-adjusted pan-cancer overall-survival Cox model"
  )
)
```

```{r pan-cancer-ph}
pan_cancer_ph <- cox.zph(pan_cancer_fit, transform = "km")
pan_cancer_ph_results <- as.data.table(
  as.data.frame(pan_cancer_ph$table),
  keep.rownames = "term"
)
setnames(pan_cancer_ph_results, old = "p", new = "p_value")
kable(
  pan_cancer_ph_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Schoenfeld residual tests"
)
```

```{r selective-pan-cancer-cox}
selective_pan_cancer_results <- rbindlist(list(

    "Overall APA usage"
  )
))
kable(
  selective_pan_cancer_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Pan-cancer selective DMAi model adjusted for overall APA usage,",
    "age, and sex"
  )
)
```


## Cancer-specific direct and selective DMAi screens

```{r cancer-variability}
cancer_variability <- analysis_data[, .(
  cancer_type = cancer_type[1L],
  patients = .N,
  deaths = sum(os_event),
  mean_dmai_usage = mean(dmai_median_usage),
  sd_dmai_usage = sd(dmai_median_usage),
  iqr_dmai_usage = IQR(dmai_median_usage),
  dmai_non_dmai_spearman = cor(
    dmai_median_usage,
    non_dmai_median_usage,
    method = "spearman"
  )
), by = project_id]
cancer_variability[
  ,
  dmai_sd_rank := frank(-sd_dmai_usage, ties.method = "min")
]
cancer_variability[
  ,
  dmai_iqr_rank := frank(-iqr_dmai_usage, ties.method = "min")
]
```

```{r cancer-screen}
fit_cancer_score <- function(
  cancer_data,
  score_term,
  analysis_name,
  additional_terms = character()
) {
  n_patients <- nrow(cancer_data)
  n_events <- sum(cancer_data$os_event)
  if (
    n_patients < params$minimum_project_patients ||
      n_events < params$minimum_project_events
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  cancer_data <- droplevels(as.data.frame(copy(cancer_data)))
  adjust_for_sex <- nlevels(cancer_data$sex) > 1L
  model_terms <- c(
    score_term,
    additional_terms,
    "age_per_10_years"
  )
  if (adjust_for_sex) {
    model_terms <- c(model_terms, "sex")
  }
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste(
    "Surv(os_months, os_event) ~",
    paste(model_terms, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      model_formula,
      data = cancer_data,
      ties = "efron",
      x = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Cancer-specific model failed for ",
        cancer_data$project_id[1L],
        " (", analysis_name, "): ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )

  target_term <- score_term
  score_result <- as.data.table(
    tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
  )[term == target_term]
  if (!nrow(score_result)) {
    stop(
      "Score term was not estimated for ",
      cancer_data$project_id[1L],
      " (", analysis_name, ")."
    )
  }

  ph_global_p <- tryCatch(
    cox.zph(fit, transform = "km")$table["GLOBAL", "p"],
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  data.table(
    analysis = analysis_name,
    project_id = cancer_data$project_id[1L],
    cancer_type = cancer_data$cancer_type[1L],
    patients = n_patients,
    deaths = n_events,
    clinical_adjustment = if (
      adjust_for_sex
    ) "Age and sex" else "Age; sex invariant",
    hazard_ratio = score_result$estimate,
    conf_low = score_result$conf.low,
    conf_high = score_result$conf.high,
    p_value = score_result$p.value,
    ph_global_p = ph_global_p
  )
}

direct_cancer_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(
    split(analysis_data, analysis_data$project_id),
    fit_cancer_score,
    score_term = "dmai_usage_z",
    analysis_name = "DMAi score"
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

selective_cancer_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(
    split(analysis_data, analysis_data$project_id),
    fit_cancer_score,
    score_term = "selective_dmai_usage_z",
    analysis_name = "Selective DMAi contrast",
    additional_terms = "overall_apa_usage_z"
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

if (!nrow(direct_cancer_results) || !nrow(selective_cancer_results)) {
  stop("No cancer project met the patient and event thresholds.")
}
if (!identical(
  sort(direct_cancer_results$project_id),
  sort(selective_cancer_results$project_id)
)) {
  stop("The direct and selective screens contain different cancer projects.")
}

cancer_screen_results <- rbindlist(list(
  direct_cancer_results,
  selective_cancer_results
))
cancer_screen_results[, p_adjusted := p.adjust(
  p_value,
  method = "BH"
), by = analysis]
cancer_screen_results[
  ,
  impact_rank := frank(-hazard_ratio, ties.method = "first")
  ,
  by = analysis
]
cancer_screen_results[
  ,
  evidence_rank := frank(p_value, ties.method = "first")
  ,
  by = analysis
]
setorder(cancer_screen_results, analysis, evidence_rank)

direct_cancer_results <- cancer_screen_results[
  analysis == "DMAi score"
]
selective_cancer_results <- cancer_screen_results[
  analysis == "Selective DMAi contrast"
]

kable(
  direct_cancer_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste0(
    "Cancer-specific direct DMAi-score models; ",
    "eligibility: n >= ",
    params$minimum_project_patients,
    " and deaths >= ",
    params$minimum_project_events
  )
)
kable(
  selective_cancer_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste0(
    "Cancer-specific selective DMAi models adjusted for overall APA; ",
    "eligibility: n >= ",
    params$minimum_project_patients,
    " and deaths >= ",
    params$minimum_project_events
  )
)
```

```{r forest-helper}
make_cancer_forest <- function(
  results,
  selected_project,
  x_label
) {
  plot_data <- copy(results)
  forest_order <- plot_data[order(hazard_ratio), project_id]
  ordered_data <- plot_data[match(forest_order, project_id)]
  ordered_labels <- paste0(
    ordered_data$project_id,
    " (n=", ordered_data$patients,
    ", deaths=", ordered_data$deaths, ")"
  )
  plot_data[, project_label := factor(
    paste0(project_id, " (n=", patients, ", deaths=", deaths, ")"),
    levels = ordered_labels
  )]
  plot_data[, selected := factor(
    fifelse(
      project_id == selected_project,
      selected_project,
      "Other eligible cancers"
    ),
    levels = c("Other eligible cancers", selected_project)
  )]

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      hazard_ratio,
      project_label,
      xmin = conf_low,
      xmax = conf_high,
      colour = selected
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "#777777") +
    geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", width = 0.15) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(
      c("#555555", "#D73027"),
      c("Other eligible cancers", selected_project)
    )) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11.5)
    )
}
```

## KIRC selective DMAi survival analysis

```{r prepare-kirc}
selected_direct_result <- direct_cancer_results[
  project_id == params$selected_direct_project
]
selected_selective_result <- selective_cancer_results[
  project_id == params$selected_selective_project
]
if (!nrow(selected_direct_result) || !nrow(selected_selective_result)) {
  stop("A selected cancer did not meet the screen eligibility criteria.")
}
if (selected_direct_result$evidence_rank != 1L) {
  warning(params$selected_direct_project, " is not first in the direct screen.")
}
if (selected_selective_result$evidence_rank != 1L) {
  warning(
    params$selected_selective_project,
    " is not first in the selective screen."
  )
}

selected_data <- copy(
  analysis_data[project_id == params$selected_selective_project]
)

prediction_levels <- names(prediction_colours)
selective_contrast_quantiles_z <- quantile(
  selected_data$selective_dmai_usage_z,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.75),
  names = FALSE
)
selective_contrast_quantiles_raw <- quantile(
  selected_data$selective_dmai_usage,
  probs = c(0.25, 0.75),
  names = FALSE
)

selected_qc <- data.table(
  project_id = params$selected_selective_project,
  patients = nrow(selected_data),
  deaths = sum(selected_data$os_event),
  dmai_non_dmai_spearman = cor(
    selected_data$dmai_median_usage,
    selected_data$non_dmai_median_usage,
    method = "spearman"
  ),
  mean_selective_contrast = mean(selected_data$selective_dmai_usage),
  sd_selective_contrast = sd(selected_data$selective_dmai_usage),
  contrast_25th_percentile = selective_contrast_quantiles_raw[1L],
  contrast_75th_percentile = selective_contrast_quantiles_raw[2L]
)
kable(
  selected_qc,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "KIRC selective DMAi contrast summary"
)
```

```{r kirc-models}
    selective_dmai_usage_z +

  data = selected_data,

  x = TRUE

kirc_model_results <- tidy_score_term(
```

```{r kirc-adjusted-survival}
plot_limit <- min(
  as.numeric(params$selected_survival_max_months),
  max(selected_data$os_months)
)
prediction_times <- seq(0, plot_limit, by = 1)

predict_marginal_survival <- function(
  fit,
  patient_data,
  contrast_value_z,
  contrast_label,
  times
) {
  counterfactual_data <- copy(patient_data)
  counterfactual_data[, selective_dmai_usage_z := contrast_value_z]
  prediction <- survfit(
    fit,
    newdata = counterfactual_data,
    se.fit = FALSE
  )
  prediction_at_times <- summary(
    prediction,
    times = times,
    extend = TRUE
  )
  predicted_survival <- prediction_at_times$surv
  if (is.null(dim(predicted_survival))) {
    predicted_survival <- matrix(
      predicted_survival,
      nrow = length(times)
    )
  } else {
    predicted_survival <- as.matrix(predicted_survival)
  }
  if (
    nrow(predicted_survival) != length(times) &&
      ncol(predicted_survival) == length(times)
  ) {
    predicted_survival <- t(predicted_survival)
  }
  if (nrow(predicted_survival) != length(times)) {
    stop("Predicted survival did not match the requested time grid.")
  }
  data.table(
    time = times,
    survival = rowMeans(predicted_survival),
    contrast_level = contrast_label
  )
}

kirc_adjusted_survival <- rbindlist(list(
  predict_marginal_survival(
    kirc_selective_fit,
    selected_data,
    selective_contrast_quantiles_z[1L],
    prediction_levels[1L],
    prediction_times
  ),
  predict_marginal_survival(
    kirc_selective_fit,
    selected_data,
    selective_contrast_quantiles_z[2L],
    prediction_levels[2L],
    prediction_times
  )
))
kirc_adjusted_survival[, contrast_level := factor(
  contrast_level,
  levels = prediction_levels
)]

bootstrap_replicates <- as.integer(
  params$survival_bootstrap_replicates
)
bootstrap_seed <- as.integer(params$survival_bootstrap_seed)
if (!is.finite(bootstrap_replicates) || bootstrap_replicates < 100L) {
  stop("`survival_bootstrap_replicates` must be at least 100.")
}
if (!is.finite(bootstrap_seed)) {
  stop("`survival_bootstrap_seed` must be a finite integer.")
}

bootstrap_prediction <- function(iteration) {
  bootstrap_indices <- sample.int(
    nrow(selected_data),
    replace = TRUE
  )
  bootstrap_data <- copy(selected_data[bootstrap_indices])
  bootstrap_fit <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      Surv(os_months, os_event) ~
        selective_dmai_usage_z +
        overall_apa_usage_z +
        age_per_10_years +
        sex,
      data = bootstrap_data,
      ties = "efron",
      x = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(bootstrap_fit)) {
    return(rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(prediction_levels) * length(prediction_times)
    ))
  }

  tryCatch(
    unlist(lapply(seq_along(prediction_levels), function(level_index) {
      predict_marginal_survival(
        bootstrap_fit,
        bootstrap_data,
        selective_contrast_quantiles_z[level_index],
        prediction_levels[level_index],
        prediction_times
      )$survival
    }), use.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(prediction_levels) * length(prediction_times)
    )
  )
}

set.seed(bootstrap_seed)
bootstrap_survival_matrix <- vapply(
  seq_len(bootstrap_replicates),
  bootstrap_prediction,
  numeric(length(prediction_levels) * length(prediction_times))
)
successful_bootstraps <- colSums(
  is.finite(bootstrap_survival_matrix)
) == nrow(bootstrap_survival_matrix)
number_successful_bootstraps <- sum(successful_bootstraps)
if (number_successful_bootstraps < 0.9 * bootstrap_replicates) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than 90% of adjusted-survival bootstrap fits succeeded (",
    number_successful_bootstraps,
    "/",
    bootstrap_replicates,
    ")."
  )
}

bootstrap_intervals <- t(apply(
  bootstrap_survival_matrix[, successful_bootstraps, drop = FALSE],
  1L,
  quantile,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  names = FALSE,
  type = 6
))
kirc_adjusted_survival[, `:=`(
  conf_low = bootstrap_intervals[, 1L],
  conf_high = bootstrap_intervals[, 2L]
)]

bootstrap_diagnostics <- data.table(
  requested_resamples = bootstrap_replicates,
  successful_resamples = number_successful_bootstraps,
  random_seed = bootstrap_seed,
  interval = "Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap CI",
  prediction_time_step_months = 1
)

survival_summary_months <- as.numeric(params$survival_summary_months)
if (
  !is.finite(survival_summary_months) ||
    survival_summary_months < 0 ||
    !survival_summary_months %in% prediction_times
) {
  stop(
    "`survival_summary_months` must be a non-negative value on the ",
    "adjusted-survival prediction grid."
  )
}
summary_row_indices <- vapply(
  prediction_levels,
  function(level) {
    matching_rows <- which(
      kirc_adjusted_survival$contrast_level == level &
        kirc_adjusted_survival$time == survival_summary_months
    )
    if (length(matching_rows) != 1L) {
      stop("Could not identify one survival-summary row per scenario.")
    }
    matching_rows
  },
  integer(1)
)
lower_usage_survival <- kirc_adjusted_survival$survival[
  summary_row_indices[1L]
]
higher_usage_survival <- kirc_adjusted_survival$survival[
  summary_row_indices[2L]
]
bootstrap_survival_difference <-
  bootstrap_survival_matrix[
    summary_row_indices[1L],
    successful_bootstraps
  ] -
  bootstrap_survival_matrix[
    summary_row_indices[2L],
    successful_bootstraps
  ]
survival_difference_interval <- quantile(
  bootstrap_survival_difference,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
  names = FALSE,
  type = 6
)

adjusted_survival_difference <- data.table(
  time_months = survival_summary_months,
  lower_relative_usage_survival = lower_usage_survival,
  higher_relative_usage_survival = higher_usage_survival,
  survival_difference_lower_minus_higher =
    lower_usage_survival - higher_usage_survival,
  difference_conf_low = survival_difference_interval[1L],
  difference_conf_high = survival_difference_interval[2L],
  interpretation = paste0(
    "Absolute adjusted survival difference; equivalently, excess ",
    "mortality risk for higher versus lower relative DMAi-site usage"
  )
)

prediction_summary <- data.table(
  contrast_level = prediction_levels,
  selective_contrast_raw = selective_contrast_quantiles_raw,
  selective_contrast_z = selective_contrast_quantiles_z
)
kable(
  prediction_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "KIRC selective-contrast values used for adjusted survival"
)
kable(
  bootstrap_diagnostics,
  caption = "Adjusted-survival bootstrap diagnostics"
)
kable(
  adjusted_survival_difference[, .(
    time_months,
    lower_relative_usage_survival,
    higher_relative_usage_survival,
    survival_difference_lower_minus_higher,
    difference_conf_low,
    difference_conf_high
  )],
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste0(
    "Adjusted survival difference at ",
    survival_summary_months,
    " months (paired-bootstrap 95% CI)"
  )
)
```

## Manuscript results paragraph

```{r manuscript-results, results='asis'}
pan_dmai <- pan_cancer_results[model == "DMAi"]
pan_non_dmai <- pan_cancer_results[model == "non-DMAi"]
pan_selective <- selective_pan_cancer_results[
  model == "Selective DMAi usage"
]
pan_overall_apa <- selective_pan_cancer_results[
  model == "Overall APA usage"
]
kirc_selective <- selected_selective_result
blca_selective <- selective_cancer_results[
  project_id == "TCGA-BLCA"
]
paad_selective <- selective_cancer_results[
  project_id == params$selected_direct_project
]
kirc_survival_difference <- adjusted_survival_difference[1L]

cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Among %s TCGA patients with primary tumours (%s deaths across %s ",
    "cancer projects), the DMAi score itself was first analysed as a ",
    "direct, non-contrast metric. Higher DMAi-site usage was associated ",
    "with poorer overall survival after adjustment for age and sex, ",
    "stratification by ",
    "cancer project, and inclusion of non-DMAi usage (HR %.2f per ",
    "within-cancer SD, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; p = %s). Non-DMAi usage was ",
    "not independently associated with survival (HR %.2f, 95%% CI ",
    "%.2f--%.2f; p = %s). In an exploratory cancer-specific screen ",
    "of %s cancer types meeting the prespecified patient and event ",
    "thresholds, pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) showed the largest ",
    "adverse DMAi association (HR %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; nominal ",
    "p = %s; BH FDR = %s). Selective DMAi usage was then defined as the ",
    "within-patient DMAi-minus-non-DMAi contrast and analysed while ",
    "controlling for overall APA usage. This contrast was not associated ",
    "with survival pan-cancer (HR %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; p = %s), ",
    "whereas overall APA usage was (HR %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; ",
    "p = %s). In the cancer-specific selective screen, kidney renal clear ",
    "cell carcinoma (KIRC) showed the strongest adverse association ",
    "(HR %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; nominal p = %s; BH FDR = %s), while ",
    "bladder urothelial carcinoma showed an inverse association (HR %.2f, ",
    "95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; nominal p = %s; BH FDR = %s). The selective ",
    "contrast was not significant in PAAD (HR %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f--%.2f; ",
    "p = %s; BH FDR = %s), indicating that direct and selective DMAi ",
    "metrics identify different cancer-specific associations. Adjusted ",
    "survival predictions with pointwise bootstrap 95%% confidence bands ",
    "at the 25th and 75th percentiles were used to visualize the continuous ",
    "KIRC association without dichotomizing patients. At %s months, adjusted ",
    "survival was %.1f%% at the 75th percentile and %.1f%% at the 25th ",
    "percentile, an absolute difference of %.1f percentage points ",
    "(paired-bootstrap 95%% CI %.1f--%.1f). These cancer-specific findings ",
    "are exploratory."
  ),
  comma(nrow(analysis_data)),
  comma(sum(analysis_data$os_event)),
  uniqueN(analysis_data$project_id),
  pan_dmai$hazard_ratio,
  pan_dmai$conf_low,
  pan_dmai$conf_high,
  format.pval(pan_dmai$p_value, digits = 2),
  pan_non_dmai$hazard_ratio,
  pan_non_dmai$conf_low,
  pan_non_dmai$conf_high,
  format.pval(pan_non_dmai$p_value, digits = 2),
  nrow(direct_cancer_results),
  selected_direct_result$hazard_ratio,
  selected_direct_result$conf_low,
  selected_direct_result$conf_high,
  format.pval(selected_direct_result$p_value, digits = 2),
  format.pval(selected_direct_result$p_adjusted, digits = 2),
  pan_selective$hazard_ratio,
  pan_selective$conf_low,
  pan_selective$conf_high,
  format.pval(pan_selective$p_value, digits = 2),
  pan_overall_apa$hazard_ratio,
  pan_overall_apa$conf_low,
  pan_overall_apa$conf_high,
  format.pval(pan_overall_apa$p_value, digits = 2),
  kirc_selective$hazard_ratio,
  kirc_selective$conf_low,
  kirc_selective$conf_high,
  format.pval(kirc_selective$p_value, digits = 2),
  format.pval(kirc_selective$p_adjusted, digits = 2),
  blca_selective$hazard_ratio,
  blca_selective$conf_low,
  blca_selective$conf_high,
  format.pval(blca_selective$p_value, digits = 2),
  format.pval(blca_selective$p_adjusted, digits = 2),
  paad_selective$hazard_ratio,
  paad_selective$conf_low,
  paad_selective$conf_high,
  format.pval(paad_selective$p_value, digits = 2),
  format.pval(paad_selective$p_adjusted, digits = 2),
  format(kirc_survival_difference$time_months, trim = TRUE),
  100 * kirc_survival_difference$higher_relative_usage_survival,
  100 * kirc_survival_difference$lower_relative_usage_survival,
  100 * kirc_survival_difference$survival_difference_lower_minus_higher,
  100 * kirc_survival_difference$difference_conf_low,
  100 * kirc_survival_difference$difference_conf_high
))
```
